t.E463.agn: In 2018 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern at the reported use levels.
t.E463.body: Celluloses are not absorbed and are largely excreted unchanged in faeces; part of them may be fermented by bacteria in the large intestine.
t.E463.prod: It is produced by treating cellulose with alkali and propylene oxide.
t.E463.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern at the reported uses.
t.E463.summary: A thickener obtained by a chemical process from cellulose in plant cell walls. It provides texture in sauces, ice cream, gluten-free products and convenience foods.
t.E463.what: It thickens and is used as a binder.
